subject: Zeppelin renewal: performance & rebid timeline
messages:
From: Jordan Mills <jmills@zeppelin.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zeppelin.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Zeppelin renewal: performance & rebid timeline

Hi Naomi / Ben,

Quick heads-up — our renewal with Redwood is coming up in ~6 weeks and the procurement team has put us on a short rebid cycle. A competitor (AsterAI) has approached us with a lower per-token price and claims they can achieve better sustained throughput on our tail workload.

Before we make any decisions we need:
- A short, side-by-side benchmark that shows p95 latency at our expected load
- A clear commercial timeline (we need an offer by Dec 6)

Can Redwood run a 1–2 week head-to-head POC against a shared prompt set? If so, please tell us what you need from our side and an ETA. Procurement is looped above.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Mills
Head of ML Infrastructure, Zeppelin.ai
[jmills@zeppelin.ai]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jmills@zeppelin.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procurement@zeppelin.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zeppelin renewal: performance & rebid timeline

Jordan — thanks for the heads-up and for looping procurement in. We can absolutely run a short, controlled head-to-head.

High-level proposal:
- 2-week POC (head-to-head) using your prompt set / traffic profile
- Dedicated cluster slice for the POC (isolated capacity) so we reproduce throughput reliably
- Measurement: sustained RPS target, p50/p95 latency, token cost delta (our runtime reports per-token cost)

What we need from you to start:
1) A representative prompt sample and current traffic profile (seq length distribution, concurrency target, and a target RPS).
2) PO for trial (we can issue a minimal SOW) or confirmation procurement will accept an evaluation order.

If that works I’ll put together a proposed MAP and timeline (goal: start POC week of Nov 29, results by Dec 10).

We’ll also prepare a short runbook describing the variants we’ll test (base model, int8 quantized variant, and an optimized kernel flow).

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
[attachment: zeppelin_sample_prompts.csv (CSV, 1.1MB) — sample prompts you can replace with your canonical set]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Jordan Mills <jmills@zeppelin.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2027 11:52:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zeppelin renewal: performance & rebid timeline

Jordan — appreciate the flag. Naomi, thanks for the plan. Two quick commercial notes:
- Zeppelin is a strategic account for H2; we should push to get a short-term uplift (3 months) that gives them breathing room while we prove throughput.
- Pricing: I can offer a limited time commercial kicker but need legal sign-off by Dec 3 to meet their procurement window.

@Markus — can you capture a first-pass SLO/throughput runbook we can reference in the MAP? @Evelyn, can you prepare a one-page onboarding timeline for a 2-week POC so procurement can see the low-risk path?

I’ll coordinate the commercial note and draft the offer once we have Markus’s perf targets.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jmills@zeppelin.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2027 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zeppelin renewal: performance & rebid timeline

Jordan — quick technical note on scope and what we’ll measure during the POC.

What we propose to run:
- Model variants: open-model-base-v2, open-model-base-v2-quant (int8), plus tuned kernel path for longer seqs.
- Metrics: sustained RPS, p50/p90/p95 token latency, memory footprint, tail latencies under KV cache warmup, and end-to-end token cost.
- Test harness: we run both sides against the same prompt set; we’ll produce a per-prompt csv of latencies and an aggregate report.

Need from you:
- Representative set of 200–500 prompts (diverse seq lengths) or a link to a hosted file;
- Target concurrent clients and desired sustained RPS (e.g., 50 RPS sustained with spikes to 80 for 10m);
- Which model family you want compared (if you’re already running a custom quantized stack with AsterAI, tell us the variant).

I’m attaching a short perf-preview so you and the team see the instrumentation we use.

—Markus
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-performance-preview.pdf (PDF, 320KB)]
From: Jordan Mills <jmills@zeppelin.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@zeppelin.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Zeppelin renewal: performance & rebid timeline

Thanks, Markus / Naomi. We’ve uploaded a canonical prompt set and traffic trace here: https://internal.dropbox.com/s/zeppelin/zepp_prompts_2027q3.csv (please let me know if the link is blocked and I’ll send via secure share). Procurement is pushing for a written offer by Dec 6.

To be explicit on targets:
- Sustained: 50 RPS
- Spike: 80 RPS (10–15 min windows)
- p95 latency target: <200ms (end-to-end generation for majority of our prompts)
- Cost objective: reduce per-token unit cost vs our current vendor by at least 15% over the next quarter

Their incumbent told us they’ll provide a custom quantized model which is part of the reason pricing looks attractive. Appreciate any color on whether you can match throughput and latency at comparable cost.

Jordan
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: Zeppelin — proposed save plan and next steps (confidential)

Team — internal save plan / recommended path to win Zeppelin back for renewal. This is internal only; do not forward.

Summary of recommended offer:
- Run the 2-week head-to-head POC starting Nov 29 (we commit to dedicated cluster slice + instrumentation).
- Commercial: 3-month uplift discount structure if they commit to a 12-month renewal post-POC. Proposed: 18% off list for first 3 months, then standard net pricing. (Ben to confirm final concession band).
- Operational SLA: provide p95 latency commitment for the trial window and an agreed rollback / fallback to alternate model variant if perf regresses.
- Support: white-glove onboarding and daily syncs during the POC; include a short escalation path to SRE.

Immediate asks (owners):
- Markus: prepare perf runbook and a first-pass expected throughput baseline by EOD Nov 26. Include what we’ll measure and the exact kernel/quant configs.
- Evelyn: onboarding timeline + minimal SOW for procurement to sign (one page).
- Ben: draft commercial letter with conditional uplift discount and timeline; need legal OK by Dec 3.

Attachments: MAP_zeppelin_v2.pdf (draft mutual action plan), zeppelin_sample_prompts.csv (Jordan’s sample we provided earlier). I’ll add the HubSpot record and a DocuSign stub in the message to procurement once Ben confirms final concession.

Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_zeppelin_v2.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Nov 2027 16:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Zeppelin — proposed save plan and next steps (confidential)

All — I reviewed the proposed concession and it’s acceptable to escalate to legal for sign-off.

Actions: I’ll send a conditional commercial letter to Jordan tomorrow morning that ties the 18% initial uplift to a signed SOW for the POC and a commitment to enter a 12-month renewal conversation post-results. I’ll CC procurement and include the DocuSign stub.

Markus — please prioritize the perf baseline run so we have numbers to include in the MAP. Evelyn — stand by to send the one-page SOW as soon as procurement confirms the PO.

I’ll post the draft commercial letter to the HubSpot record and ping legal for a fast-track review.

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
